Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by December 31?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (12% odds) on crude reach the strike. Closes in ~3mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (6% odds) on crude reach $110. Closes in 9d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Market pricing 77% odds crude will drop below $90. Closes in 9d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 96% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.

Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 48% YES on this outcome.

Trade & Policy.title: Will China’s CPI increase by between 0.7% and 0.8% over the 12 month period ending in September 2026?
Trade & Policy.why_it_matters: China is the world's largest soybean buyer -- any policy shift moves US ag exports.
